sources.title: Dr. Qwen: Fine-tuning & Evaluating Medical LLMs from 0.6B to 8B with ...
sources.snippet: All fine-tuned model adapters were pushed to the Hugging Face Hub, making them available for further experimentation. At this point, I decided to give shape to the lightest model. The Medical AI Chatbot on Hugging Face Qwen3-0.6B with the medical LoRA adapter has been deployed as a publicly accessible chatbot on Hugging Face Spaces.
